evidence.title: Grokking the System Design Interview: The Original Course

name: Grokking the System Design Interview
summary: The original Grokking system design interview course: 82 lessons, 15+ case studies and a repeatable interview framework.
description: A paid, self-paced course by Arslan Ahmad, ex-Meta hiring manager: a step-by-step interview framework, trade-off drills (latency vs throughput, SQL vs NoSQL, monolith vs microservices), core distributed systems concepts and 15+ end-to-end case studies including URL shortener, Instagram, Twitter, Uber, Dropbox and Netflix. 4 chapters, 82 lessons, 11 videos, 237 assessments, about 20 hours; $148 one-time with lifetime access, discussions and a certificate.
